summary: The filled primary button (ui/button default variant) paints a new fixed --color-primary-fill (#1f6feb, hover #1a5bc9) instead of --accent, so its white label reads at 4.6:1 (6.2:1 on hover) in dark, light and translucent. In dark and translucent it was 2.5:1. --accent itself is unchanged, so links, focus rings and chips keep their colour.

reactNativeIos.reason: Renderer-only Tailwind token for the desktop shadcn Button; the Expo app has its own palette and button components.

nativeAndroid.reason: Renderer-only Tailwind token for the desktop shadcn Button; the Android app uses its own Compose theme.

sharedBackendApi.reason: One CSS token in the renderer; no API change.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop release; no packaging change.

automated: tests/unit/primary-fill-contrast.test.ts reads both fill tokens from tailwind.css, requires white on each at 4.5:1 or better, and checks the default variant paints them; it fails before the change.
Visual screens phase: 39 baselines with a filled primary button refreshed (each checked by pixel diff, a sample by eye), 16 noise baselines reverted, then two runs without updating passed.
npm run typecheck and npm test.
notExercised: Hover colour is not in any screenshot; only the contrast test covers it.
